description: This file implements the SystemInfo class and related nested classes for gathering and managing system information within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes methods for registering notifications, retrieving device identifiers, network info, security, location, and system version details.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class providing system information and notification management within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Nested class providing network-related information such as IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Security
classes.description: Nested class providing security-related information such as callsign.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Nested class providing location details such as timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Nested class providing device identifier details including architecture, chipset, firmware version, and a method to retrieve the identifier.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Time
classes.description: Nested class providing time synchronization information.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Register
methods.description: Registers a notification client to receive system info updates.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification client from receiving system info updates.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RawDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the specified network interface or the first available MAC address if no interface is specified.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Update
methods.description: Triggers an update of system information and notifies registered clients.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RecursiveList
methods.description: Recursively calls the Updated method on notification clients.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Internet::PublicIPAddress
methods.description: Returns the current public IP address.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Internet::NetworkType
methods.description: Returns the network type (IPv4, IPv6, or unknown).

methods.name: SystemInfo::Internet::Set
methods.description: Sets the internet info based on provided data.

methods.name: SystemInfo::BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Returns the build tree hash string.
